title: Multiplication carry sequence
statement: For Boolean lists $a,b$, define a sequence of natural-number carries by setting the carry at index $0$ to $0$ and, for each $j\ge 0$, setting the carry at index $j+1$ to the quotient obtained by dividing the sum of the carry at $j$ and the multiplication column sum at $j$ by $2$.
